fusions.name: Burst from the Reeds
fusions.desc: Springs from where you crouch to a target up to 6 tiles away and strikes it for 32 damage, always a critical hit, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Wet-Skin Splash
fusions.desc: Slaps the damp ground, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 30% chance of [Soaked] for 5 seconds. You regain 2 health.

fusions.name: Spring and Mend
fusions.desc: Springs you 3 tiles and restores 20 stamina. Your damp skin knits, restoring 6 health to whoever in your party is worst off.

fusions.name: Coiled Haunches
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
